## Checklist

- [ ] `fvm flutter analyze` reports no issues
- [ ] `fvm flutter test` passes, new behavior has tests
- [ ] `fvm dart format` applied
- [ ] Strings are localized (PL and EN), no hard-coded colors or spacing
- [ ] UI checked in light and dark theme
- [ ] No secrets, tokens or personal data in code or logs
- [ ] `AGENTS.md` / `docs/` updated if a rule or decision changed
